methodology.data_source: Existing independently audited, amendment-combined 13F holdings. No re-download and no original dataset changes.
methodology.company_aggregation: Group by observed issuer and CUSIP issuer prefix; reviewed identity aliases handle changed/as-filed identifiers. Aggregate classes, including common/preferred or tracking classes issued by the same legal issuer, once.
methodology.distinct_issuers: Liberty Media, Liberty Global, Liberty Latin America, Liberty Live Holdings, Sirius XM, Atlanta Braves and Starz remain distinct issuers when separately listed.
methodology.denominator: All reported 13F rows, including index-fund positions, retain the exact established total. Funds/options are excluded only from individual-company ranking.
methodology.history: Later amendments and confidential-treatment releases are included as in the prior audited history; this is not an original-publication-time trading simulation.
methodology.cash: Cash uses the established allocation_data.json unchanged. Its period-specific accounting scope and payable limitations remain applicable.
methodology.units: USD integer strings; percentages are stored as dimensionless Decimal fractions.
